title: feat(index): add widget [PART-1]
body:
The current implementation manages all the aspect of the search at the InstantSearch level (lifecycle, widgets, render, ...). This PR introduces an `index` widget that will take some of those responsibilities.

The InstantSearch instance will be responsible to expose global state/methods for the `index` widgets. Each `index` widget own a local Helper to manage the state of the index with the widgets attach to it. By default, each InstantSearch instance will be created with an `index`. The calls to `addWidgets` & `removeWidgets` are forwarded to the `index`. One important thing to note is that the `index` does not make the queries. It delegates this operation with a DerivedHelper to the "main" Helper created at the InstantSearch level.

This split of responsibilities will allow multiple `index` inside the same instance. Currently, the feature is not "enabled" because the derivation function only looks up for [the local state](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3892/files#diff-f82164a0b1338f78fd22259b6552aed0R197). The idea is to resolve the parent until the root and create the `SearchParameters` for the current index. This will be possible once we're able to merge the `SearchParameters`.

At the moment the `index` widget is not connected to anything. The next PR will introduce its usage at the `InstantSearch` level. We'll take this opportunity to remove all the duplicated tests that we have between `InstantSearch` & `index`.
